entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I...
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I have the order number ready.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. What's the order number, please?
It's VF771-09-B. It's for a jersey.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order from early November. Just so I can note it correctly in the system, what specifically was the issue with the jersey?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight. I just need to send it back. Can I get an exchange or what's the process?
I understand. Let me just confirm the return eligibility... Yes, that item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
Great. So you'll send me a label?
Yes. We can process this as a return for a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for the correct size if you'd like.
A refund is fine. I'll just reorder later. Just send the return label to the email on file.
Perfect. I've just sent that pre-paid return label to you. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Nope, that's it. Got the email. Thanks.
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
